sources.title: Spine User Guide: Skins
sources.application: Reusable attachment sets; architectural reference for compatible modules, not a chosen runtime.

sources.title: Spine User Guide: Slots
sources.application: Render attachments and draw order can be separate from the bone hierarchy.

sources.title: Spine User Guide: IK constraints
sources.application: Target-driven one/two-bone control and explicit bend direction.

sources.title: Ryan Juckett: Analytic Two-Bone IK in 2D
sources.application: Reach annulus, bend solution and unreachable-target handling. Independent probe code was written for this study.

sources.title: Aristidou and Lasenby: FABRIK author page, Graphical Models 2011
sources.application: Position-based iterative IK supporting constrained and multiple-chain extensions; candidate for longer tool chains.

sources.title: Bai et al.: CPG-Based Gait Generation of the Curved-Leg Hexapod Robot with Smooth Gait Transition, Sensors 2019
sources.application: Tripod, quadruped and wave support schedules, duty factors and support-region interpretation.

sources.title: Liu et al.: Fault-Tolerant Tripod Gait Planning and Verification of a Hexapod Robot, Applied Sciences 2020
sources.application: Failed-leg placement and support geometry affect a compensating gait. This is robotics research, not validation of our sprites.

sources.title: Saint11: Cluster Sketching and Painting
sources.application: Large coherent color masses precede small details; isolated pixels can create visual noise.

sources.title: Saint11: Pixel Art Tutorials
sources.application: Author tutorial catalogue includes silhouette, fabric, looping and animation topics. Catalogue consulted; no claim every tutorial image was studied in depth.

sources.title: Aseprite documentation: Command Line Interface
sources.application: Batch PNG/JSON export, frame tags, slice data and export padding controls.

sources.title: Aseprite documentation: Slices
sources.application: Named bounds and pivots can be included in exported JSON.

sources.title: MDN: CanvasRenderingContext2D.imageSmoothingEnabled
sources.application: Disable smoothing for sharp enlarged pixel previews; does not prove artistic quality.

sources.title: Glenn Fiedler: Fix Your Timestep
sources.application: Separate simulation step from display timing and control timestep for reproducibility.

sources.title: Ryan Juckett: Damped Springs
sources.application: Settling responses can smooth secondary motion; deterministic baking is our proposed application.

sources.title: Godot stable documentation: Using AnimationTree
sources.application: Animation data, playback control, filtered layers and one-shot semantics are distinct. No engine migration proposed.

sources.title: PixiJS v8.5.1 API: SpritesheetFrameData
sources.application: Frame rectangle, source dimensions, trim offsets and anchor fields are distinct metadata.

sources.title: MDN: WebGL best practices
sources.application: Budget decoded GPU memory and account for device capability differences; Canvas limits require separate measurement.

sources.title: JSON Schema: Conditional schema validation
sources.application: Conditional requirements can constrain modular definitions; graph validity still needs semantic checks.

sources.title: Aseprite documentation source: Rotation
sources.application: Editor documentation distinguishes Fast Rotation and RotSprite. No resampling algorithm was imported.

sources.title: W3C WCAG 2.2, sections 2.3.1–2.3.3
sources.application: Effect review reference for flashing and disableable motion; no conformance claim.

sources.title: Esoteric Software: Spine Runtimes License Agreement
sources.application: Reference software has specific runtime terms; study recommends no runtime dependency or source-code import.

sources.title: Aseprite official repository README
sources.application: Source visibility does not mean the full application is permissively licensed. No application source imported.
